syllabus_topics: Selection of ball and roller bearings
Comments on the different bearing options
assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, the subject will be evaluated based on two (2) to three (3) intermediate exams worth between 1 and 1.5 points each, which will not release material and will be part of the final grade. The final exam will cover all topics and will be worth between 5.5 and 8 points, added to the intermediate exam scores. For the extraordinary call, the evaluation will cover the entire subject; intermediate exams will not be considered, and the student must take the complete exam. Any attempt at fraud, copying, plagiarism, or other irregular behavior constitutes a serious infraction.
